text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, it's time for the fourth<n>preseason match of
the Unity Cup!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Breathe in... breathe out... and focus!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're ready to go!
Looks like you're ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hm, I want to be extra prepared.<n>We're going
up against an<n>undefeated team, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: They must be really good, if they've<n>never lost...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So I've got to try my absolute hardest<n>today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Hehe... I'm nervous, but I may<n>also be getting
a little... excited.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I think, um... it'd probably make<n>everyone really
happy if we won<n>today's match.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Our opponents might be tough, but<n>we've all been
training really hard for<n>this, so we're all really tough
too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I know we'll be fine.<n>We've done it
so many times in<n>practice, haven't we? So now...
We<n>just have to do it for real!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll do my very best!
